attr.title: TOMOMI
attr.desc:
A new superweapon has been developed by the evil organization Animalia.
Enter Tomomi, a hero for hire. Joining her is Riko, the supporter.
Their mission...infiltrate the Animalia complex and stop their evil plans!
Will Tomomi and Riko be able to find and destroy the new weapon!?
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder. This game is recommended primarily for devices with RK3566 cpu or better for performance reasons.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1229390/TOMOMI/) and copy all game files into `assets` folder. This game is recommended primarily for devices with `RK3566` cpu or better for performance reasons.
